mobile.team_bridge.actions.select_text.note: Row in the message-actions sheet that lets the reader select part of the message with drag handles, then copy or share it. Slack's label for the same action. Also a screen-reader action on the message.

mobile.team_bridge.actions.title.note: Accessible name and title of the sheet that rises when a Team Bridge message is long-pressed (Slack-style message menu). Names the menu, not an action.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.add.note: Accessible name of the "+" control that adds an emoji reaction to a message: the last cell of the quick-reaction row (opens the system emoji keyboard) and the small "+" after a message's reaction pills.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.added.note: Polite screen-reader announcement after the reader's reaction was saved.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.failed.note: Shown in small red text under a message, and announced, when adding or removing a reaction failed; the previous reactions are restored. Tapping again retries.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.hint_add.note: Screen-reader hint on a reaction pill the reader has not reacted with: double-tapping adds the same emoji as their own reaction.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.hint_remove.note: Screen-reader hint on a reaction pill the reader has reacted with: double-tapping removes their reaction.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.keyboard_hi.note: One line shown above the system keyboard after tapping "+" to add a reaction: the reader picks any emoji from their phone's emoji keyboard. Letters typed are ignored.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.pill.note: Screen-reader name of one reaction pill under a message, when the reader has NOT reacted with it. {emoji} is the emoji itself; VoiceOver/TalkBack speak its system name (e.g. "thumbs up"). {count} is how many people reacted with it. Keep the order natural for your language.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.pill_mine.note: Screen-reader name of one reaction pill when the reader HAS reacted with it (the pill is highlighted). Same as mobile.team_bridge.reactions.pill plus "you reacted". Example: "thumbs up, 3 reactions, you reacted".

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.removed.note: Polite screen-reader announcement after the reader's reaction was removed.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.summary.note: Spoken once before a message's reaction pills: the total number of reactions across all emoji on that message.

mobile.team_bridge.delivery.help.note: Fixed message-delivery explanation for every state/category. Conditional rephrasing is general guidance, not a retry action or per-category evasion advice. No raw reasons, scores, identifiers, blame or promised acceptance.

mobile.team_bridge.delivery.help_action.note: Fixed message-delivery explanation for every state/category. Conditional rephrasing is general guidance, not a retry action or per-category evasion advice. No raw reasons, scores, identifiers, blame or promised acceptance.

mobile.team_bridge.list.catching_up.note: Team Bridge mobile UI: list / calm status shown when Radient has asked the app to slow down (rate limit) for longer than one short wait. The app is already retrying on its own and any rows already loaded stay visible; there is no button. Not an error: keep it calm and brief, never mention HTTP, 429 or limits.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.dismiss_noti.note: Team Bridge @-mention notice: dismiss button. Short verb.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.invited.note: Team Bridge @-mention notice after picking someone invited but not yet joined: no notification is sent. {name} is user data.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.no_endpoint.note: Team Bridge @-mention notice after picking an agent whose address is not known yet because the people list has not loaded: no notification is sent. {name} is user data.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.not_member.note: Team Bridge @-mention notice after picking someone who is not in the conversation: their name stays in the message but no notification is sent. {name} is user data. Do not imply an invite is sent.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.results_coun.note: Team Bridge @-mention suggestions: spoken to screen readers when the suggestion list changes. Counts people and agents offered. Preserve the ICU plural.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.row_label.note: Team Bridge @-mention suggestions: accessibility label for one suggestion row. {name} is a person or agent display name (user data, never translated).

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.section_memb.note: Team Bridge @-mention suggestions: heading over people and agents who are members of the open conversation. Short; shown above the keyboard.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.section_org.note: Team Bridge @-mention suggestions: heading over people and agents in the organization who are not in this conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.mentions.unavailable.note: Team Bridge @-mention suggestions: shown when the organization directory has not loaded, so only conversation members can be suggested. No error code; calm tone.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.count.note: Reply-thread affordance on a Team Bridge message: how many replies the thread under this message has. Served by the hub, never counted on the phone. Preserve {count}.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.open.note: Accessible name of the control that opens a message's reply thread (Slack-style threads); matches the desktop's 'View thread, …'. Preserve {count}. 'Thread' means replies under one message, not the whole conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.open_unr.note: Same control when some replies are unread by this reader. Preserve {count} and {unread}.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.title.note: Screen title for one message's reply thread (the message and its replies). Not the whole conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.loading.note: Shown while a reply thread loads.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.more.note: Button at the end of a very long reply thread (more than one load of replies) that loads the next replies. No parameters; matches the desktop's 'Load more replies'.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.error.note: Shown when a reply thread could not be read from Radient; a retry button follows.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.empty.note: A reply thread whose root message has no replies left to show; the second sentence invites the reader to write the first reply (desktop wording).

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.reply.note: Composer label and placeholder for replying inside a thread; matches the desktop's 'Reply in thread'. A verb phrase: write a reply in this thread, not in the conversation.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.details.note: Read-only reaction summary sheet heading; never implies verified identities.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.sample.note: Sample labels in original hub order, joined by locale list formatting. count is total minus sample length; ownership is independent. Zero must omit others suffix.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.sample_noti.note: Explicitly explains that sample labels are not a full reactor roster.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.you_reacted.note: Independent reacted_by_me boolean. Never replace or reorder sample labels with this string.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.show_more.note: Expand collapsed reaction types; count counts hidden emoji pills, not people.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.show_less.note: Collapse to three measured lines of pills.

mobile.team_bridge.reply_thread.last_rep.note: Served last_reply_at formatted as an absolute local date/time; never infer from visible replies.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.hint_inspec.note: Read-only reaction pill: tap inspects the summary, never mutates it.

mobile.team_bridge.reactions.sample_none.note: The summary includes a total count but no sample labels. Do not imply missing actors or a full roster endpoint.
